title: render free database expiry
linkedin:
> Yes.

Per Render's docs, free PostgreSQL instances expire roughly 30 days after they're created; you get warnings and a short grace period, and if you don't upgrade or migrate, the database is deleted along with its data. The fix: run `pg_dump` now to get a backup, then restore into a persistent managed database that doesn't expire. Don't wait for the last warning email.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/render-free-database-expiry/
